dialect.detail: GnuCOBOL student project; 'Tectonics: cobc' comment confirms cobc compiler; uses SCREEN SECTION with LINE/COL clauses typical of GnuCOBOL terminal I/O
evidence: SCREEN SECTION with BLANK SCREEN LINE COL

purpose.domain_detail: College/university student records system — project 3 assignment involving indexed file I/O and screen-based student report display
purpose.summary: A student exercise program that accepts a student ID key from a screen, opens an indexed sequential file of student records, reads to find a matching record, and displays the student's name, tuition owed, program of study, and course codes/averages on a formatted screen. It then offers options to search again, edit, or quit.

notable_features: SCREEN SECTION with LINE/COL positioning and BLANK SCREEN
Indexed sequential file with RECORD KEY (ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED)
Fixed-format source with max line length 72
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
Incomplete implementation: comments note missing COMPUTE for totals
All course display items share same LINE 12 COL (likely a bug)
verdict.notes: The filename 'project3-welcome.cbl' and the comment header with blank Author/Date/Purpose fields strongly indicate a student assignment. The output screen has a likely bug where all five course code/average fields are placed on LINE 12 COL 25/48 instead of incrementing lines. The FIND-MATCH paragraph only reads one record rather than looping, which is another incomplete implementation detail. Comments marked '*>' indicate GnuCOBOL-style inline comments.
